prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Ashkar Veilhand. Character visual motifs: masked ash monk wearing charred prayer banners and iron ash bells; no invisible assassin smoke.
TOP LEFT: Witness the Hurt. Ability concept: every 50 damage one chosen nearby ally takes from an enemy creates one Ember Count on that attacker (max 3); counts expire in 5 s.
TOP RIGHT: Ember Brand. Ability concept: marks one attacker with a burn that grows with Ember Count; if they stop attacking the protected ally, the burn ends early.
BOTTOM LEFT: Ash Intercession. Ability concept: Ashkar dashes **only to his sworn ally**, landing at a legal adjacent location and briefly blocking the next targeted basic attack for them. No stealth or enemy-target jump.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Public Penance. Ability concept: announces the top Ember Count attacker for 0.8 s, then creates a circular duel hazard around **that enemy's current position**. Damage ramps only while the accused continues attacking Ashkar's protected ally; they can switch targets or exit. No guaranteed execution.
